column1: # The boxes of the class scheme (docs/source/developer/classes.rst), one row per box; make_figures.py draws them.
# Columns, tab-separated: type, file, job, figure, kind, state.
#   type    the name as the code spells it (a namespace prefix is shown; the check looks for the last component)
#   file    where it is declared: kind class -> "class X" / "struct X" in that file (repo_consistency check 44);
#           kind target -> add_library / add_executable / pybind11_add_module of X in that CMakeLists.txt;
#   figure  libraries, setup, evaluation, inference, frontends (a type may have one row per figure)
#   state   immutable (built at set-up, then only read), evaluation (written by every evaluation, owned by the
#           caller), or run (neither: a run's or a session's object)
